metadata.title: A singular minimizer of a uniformly convex Hessian-dependent functional
metadata.abstract: We construct a smooth, uniformly convex Hessian-dependent energy functional, which admits a singular $C^{1,1}$ minimizer on $\mathbb{R}^5$ that is a two-homogeneous normalization of Cartan's five-dimensional cubic. Our construction relies on constructing a quadratic null Lagrangian for the Hessian that is suitably non-degenerate on the image of the Hessian for the candidate minimizer. This complements a partial regularity result previously obtained by the authors in this setting, and demonstrates that one cannot hope for a fourth-order version of classical second-order elliptic regularity theory à la De Giorgi-Nash-Moser.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 一致凸四阶变分的奇异反例
analysis.workSummary: 存在F∈C∞(Sym(5))，其二阶导在所有对称矩阵上有统一上下正界。Cartan三次型P的二次齐次归一化u=P/|x|（u(0)=0）在五维单位球内弱解div div DF(D²u)=0，并对每个φ∈W₀^{2,2}满足能量差≥(λ/2)∫|D²φ|²。因此u是在光滑边界数据u=P、∂νu=2P下的唯一极小元，属于W^{2,∞}且仅在原点非C²。加上惰性变量的构造使任意n≥5维都有奇异集恰为余维5平面与单位球交集的例子。
techniques: Cartan等参三次型与SO(3)共轭对称性
analysis.breakthrough: 寻找L=L₀+bL₁，使Hessian像K中任意M、N的差满足L(M−N)≥σ|M−N|²。该下界允许一致凸延拓F在K上保持F=L和DF=DL，零Lagrangian因而给出弱方程，统一凸下界再给出定量唯一极小性。
analysis.limitations: 定位并补读PDF第1–6、19–20页相关段落，渲染第3页。余维5是本文例子的奇异集维数，任意极小元的最优普遍维数界仍开放。Remark 1.3的严格凸一维例子属于另一正则性问题。本次未独立核验零Lagrangian的完整代数推导、外部凸延拓引理或整篇证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第6页明确披露用AI协助识别合适二次零Lagrangian所需的部分代数计算，记录computation。作者说明主证明策略和Cartan型候选均由作者提出，相关计算与论证经作者大幅重做，全文由作者撰写。声明另把第4页Remark 1.3中仅严格凸的辅助例子想法归于AI，归因限于该例子。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20396v1 · PDF第6页Note on LLM Usage及第4页Remark 1.3，全文23页。
